ops.name: difference

ops.name: ratio

anchor.title: Event
anchor.description: What the events are aligned on: Meal (a carb entry), CorrectionBolus (a manual bolus with no meal near it), SensorStart, ExerciseStart, OverrideStart, TemporaryTargetStart, UnannouncedRise (a meal-like rise with no carbs logged), LowStart, HighStart, SiteChange (a site, cannula or pod change), SleepStart and Wake (the start and end of a sleep session, naps included; need the sleep permission), LowTreatment (the first carbs logged during a low) or AnyBolus (every manual bolus, for a meal or not). LowStart is the first reading of a low and HighStart the first reading of a high, by the rule the glucose statistics count lows and highs by: a low starts after at least 15 minutes of readings below 70 mg/dL (3.9 mmol/L), a high after at least 15 minutes above 180 mg/dL (10.0 mmol/L), and each ends after at least 15 minutes back in range or at a gap in the readings. These limits are the same for everyone, not the profile's target.

datasets.label: Meals and events
datasets.description: Glucose after meals and other events, in up to six groups that you filter.

anchor.title: Event
anchor.description: What the events are aligned on: Meal (a carb entry), CorrectionBolus (a manual bolus with no meal near it), SensorStart, ExerciseStart, OverrideStart, TemporaryTargetStart, UnannouncedRise (a meal-like rise with no carbs logged), LowStart, HighStart, SiteChange (a site, cannula or pod change), SleepStart and Wake (the start and end of a sleep session, naps included; need the sleep permission), LowTreatment (the first carbs logged during a low) or AnyBolus (every manual bolus, for a meal or not). LowStart is the first reading of a low and HighStart the first reading of a high, by the rule the glucose statistics count lows and highs by: a low starts after at least 15 minutes of readings below 70 mg/dL (3.9 mmol/L), a high after at least 15 minutes above 180 mg/dL (10.0 mmol/L), and each ends after at least 15 minutes back in range or at a gap in the readings. These limits are the same for everyone, not the profile's target.
